notes: v0.3.84: Reconnect after leaving or restarting now works. STUN retries while WiFi comes back up (no more 'all STUN servers failed' on rejoin) and falls back to a free port if the old one is busy. When your peer drops you now get a 'Lost connection' banner that tells you both to reconnect with the same code. A broken video source (e.g. OBS virtual camera) no longer locks you out: it resets to the default camera, and you can pick a camera source BEFORE turning video on. Single-channel Input volume fader and Picture-in-Picture pop-out from the prior build are included.
